# @univerjs-pro/thread-comment-resource

`@univerjs-pro/thread-comment-resource` is part of Univer Pro. Thread comment resource integration for Univer Pro.

## Package Overview

| Package | UMD global | CSS | Locales | Facade entry |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| `@univerjs-pro/thread-comment-resource` | `UniverProThreadCommentResource` | No | No | No |

## Installation

```sh
pnpm add @univerjs-pro/thread-comment-resource
# or
npm install @univerjs-pro/thread-comment-resource
```

Keep all `@univerjs/*` and `@univerjs-pro/*` packages on the same version.

## Usage

```ts
import { UniverThreadCommentResourcePlugin } from '@univerjs-pro/thread-comment-resource';

univer.registerPlugin(UniverThreadCommentResourcePlugin);
```

## Integration Notes

- Keep this package on the same version as the other `@univerjs/*` and `@univerjs-pro/*` packages in your application.
